name: Wor Games
storyline:
Death-matches between prisoners and monsters are fought in ever more difficult arenas known as dungeons.

Some monsters only become visible in the same hallway as a player but can be tracked on the radar.

The dungeon master, known as the Wizard of Wor may appear to seek revenge if you kill his pet worluk.
summary:
Play either single player (with CPU team mate) or 2 player co-op.

This game is inspired by the 1981 Midway arcade game Wizard of Wor and the fantastic 1984 version for the commodore 64.

I have fond memories of playing this game with my dad in the 1980s. He's now 85 at the time of release!

This is for you, dad xxx
